en: A monochrome (blue‑tinted) postcard view of a mountain landscape. In the foreground there is a two‑story house with dark shutters beside a winding road lined with trees and grass. Coniferous trees partially obscure the house, and beyond them a valley with terraced fields stretches toward high, snow‑streaked mountains under a partly cloudy sky. A caption at the bottom margin names the location and its elevation.
